text:
Alex P.: Hey team, sync request — VaultGrid wants a coordinated marketplace + launch announcement for their HSM/BYOK + SCIM/SSO integration. Need a short, actionable playbook for onboarding, security checklist, and press embargo timing. Who can lead? :calendar:
Maria (PM): I can own the playbook. Need engineering checklist and legal signoff dates. Targeting a soft launch on 2026-05-12, embargo 5/19 for public. Is that feasible?
Simon - Eng: Feasible if we get VaultGrid's SAML metadata and SCIM base URL by EOD Thu. Engineering items: SCIM 2.0 user provisioning (+bulk sync), SAML IdP metadata, JWK endpoint for BYOK wrap keys, and cert rotation plan.
Jia (Sales): We'll need a joint PR draft and partner quote. Also channel partners want co-sell materials — deck + 1-pager. Can marketing start a skeleton doc now?
Simon - Eng: Quick note on BYOK handshake: we expect a 3-step flow — vendor publishes encrypted wrapping key (JWE), we verify attestation, then certify the key id. I can share a sample curl flow:
```
# sample BYOK POST (very high level)
curl -X POST https://partner.example.com/byo/handshake \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"kid":"vaultgrid-key-123","wrapped_key":"<jwe>"}'
```
Maria (PM): Perfect. Also adding compliance gating: SOC2 evidence, penetration test report, and KMS crypto review. Legal wants DPA + security addendum signed before marketplace listing. Timeline for legal review?
Jia (Sales): Legal usually needs 7-10 business days. We can parallel run marketing + engineering, but listing won't go live until signed. Recommend we lock the embargo but be ready to flip on publish once legal clears.
SecBot: Security review status: automated scan completed — low findings (3 informational). Manual crypto review pending assignment (ETA 4 business days).
Alex P.: Can Simon send the minimal SCIM schema and SAML meta snippet we require? I'll consolidate into the onboarding playbook and ping legal. Maria, can you own the checklist doc and create a shared folder?
Maria (PM): Yep — creating folder now: /shared/partners/vaultgrid-onboard. I'll populate checklist and add owners per row.
Simon - Eng: Dropping the required SCIM attributes for us: userName, name.familyName, name.givenName, emails[type=work], externalId. Also we expect PATCH support for updates.
Jia (Sales): I'll draft the partner quote and ask marketing to start the co-sell deck. If legal is the gating item we should communicate an estimated publish window to VaultGrid.
Alex P.: Action items recap: Maria -> playbook + folder; Simon -> SCIM/SAML/BYOK sample + cert rotation notes (due EOD Thu); Jia -> partner PR + co-sell deck draft; Legal -> DPA + addendum (tracked separately). I'll do weekly sync cadence (Wednesdays). Thanks :thumbsup:
Maria (PM): Adding items to checklist now, tagging owners.
Simon - Eng: Will post the sample SAML metadata and a tiny test harness repo link in the folder when ready.
Jia (Sales): Noted — scheduling partner briefing for next Tue.
SecBot: Reminder: please attach pen-test report to the shared folder once available.
